prompts.text: Name a film or TV show with a number in its title
prompts.note: In digits or in words. Sequel numbers don't count: 'Toy Story 2' won't do!

decoys.name: Fast Five
decoys.why: Sneaky! That 'five' is a sequel number.

decoys.name: 2 Fast 2 Furious
decoys.why: That 2 is a sequel number in disguise!

decoys.name: Squid Game
decoys.why: No number in the title, though there are 456 players!

prompts.text: Name a board game or card game
prompts.note: Played at a table, with a board, cards, tiles or dice. Video games don't count.

decoys.name: Twister
decoys.why: You play that one on the floor!

decoys.name: Rubik's Cube
decoys.why: A puzzle, not a game for the table.

decoys.name: Five Stones
decoys.why: A playground game, not a table one.

prompts.note: From any orchestra, band or tradition. Your voice doesn't count!

decoys.name: Voice
decoys.why: Lovely, but your voice doesn't count here!

decoys.name: Microphone
decoys.why: It makes music louder, but you don't play it.

decoys.name: Metronome
decoys.why: It keeps time, but it doesn't play a tune.
